html:
SMTO-TSK-0012 — Your answer or follow-up couldn't be sent

GUID: 535ddb8a-dd3c-469e-a850-c9a997075db1
Slug: followup-required
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • SMTO couldn't accept the message you sent to the task. It was empty, too long, or sent in a way SMTO couldn't match to your earlier message. Your text wasn't sent to the Agent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Make sure the box has real text, not only spaces or blank lines. SMTO doesn't send empty answers or follow-ups to the Agent.
  2. Shorten long text. Keep an answer to a question under 8,000 characters and a follow-up message under 24,000. Add large content with Add context instead of pasting it. Messages over these limits are refused before they reach the task.
  3. If the text is fine, reload the SMTO page. Then send it again from the message box, or from Provide input on the task's latest reply if it asked you a question. An out-of-date page can send your text without the details SMTO needs to match it to the task.

What success looks like

  • Your message appears in the conversation and the task continues.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep sending the same text unchanged; it will be refused for the same reason.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An answer or follow-up was rejected: it was blank, the wrong type or too long (answers allow up to 8,000 characters, follow-ups 1 to 24,000), or the request lacked the submission ID it needs.

What this means

  • An answer/follow-up is empty, wrong-typed or beyond its boundary's limit, conflicts with restart, or lacks a valid bounded submission identity. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • An answer/follow-up is empty, wrong-typed or beyond its boundary's limit, conflicts with restart, or lacks a valid bounded submission identity.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the relevant answer/follow-up limit and submission ID; activity answers allow 8000 characters while follow-ups allow 24000.

How to fix it

  • Check the payload: answers must be nonblank text of at most 8,000 characters, follow-up amendments 1 to 24,000 characters, and a follow-up or cancel_steer action must carry its submission_id. Fix the input and submit it through the matching pending-interaction or follow-up control; the browser client supplies the IDs, so a missing ID points to an outdated page or a custom client.
  • Correct the response length/type or submission identity and use the matching interaction or follow-up control.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported nonempty response with a valid identity is accepted by the intended pending interaction.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
